title: SIDESTORY: A WALK IN THE DUST OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: A WALK IN THE DUST OPEN
EVENT DURATION: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 21, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: A Walk in The Dust event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Walk Alone] Duration: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[The Endless Road] Duration: October 7, 2021, 16:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[SONG OF DUST]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Song of Dust] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Heavyrain, Critical Response Team Office (Pieces), Scattered Sketches.
[REEFSTEEP BLACK MARKET]
DURATION: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 21, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Scattered Sketches by clearing event stages and Song of Dust missions. Scattered Sketches can be used to redeem items.
MAIN REWARDS: Heavyrain's Token, Critical Response Team Office (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Records, Elite Materials, Furniture Parts, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ERG PASSENGER
DURATION: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Erg Passenger", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Passenger
★★★★★: Toddifons / Sesa
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Erg Passenger", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
★★★★★★: Passenger
★★★★★: Toddifons
NOTE:
Operator Heavyrain is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event A Walk in The Dust. Operator Heavyrain is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Passenger, Toddifons, and Heavyrain will gain more trust in the event stages.
04 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Octopath Illusion for Hellagur
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Wind of Breaking Blade for Shirayuki
05 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Stronghold for Saria
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Distinguished Visitor for Angelina
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Refined Horrormare for Lappland
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Titleless Code for Executor
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Homecoming for GreyThroat
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Seventh Night's Awakened for Midnight
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – CRITICAL RESPONSE TEAM OFFICE
DURATION: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Critical Response Team Office, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
A Walk in The Dust event rewards and redeem in event shop (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 RECRUITMENT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: September 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment:
★★★★★★: Mostima
★★★★★: Waai Fu
